Use this guide to review and rate HALFpipe’s output images. If you’re still checking for missing files or failed runs, start with [3. Run and check outputs](check_run.qmd).

[Prepare for QC](qc/before-starting.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Rate the reports](qc/reports.qmd#explore-reports){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
[Cheat Sheet](qc/cheat-sheet.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Workflow

::: {.qc-workflow-grid}

::: {.qc-nav-card}
[4.2 Prepare for QC](qc/before-starting.qmd){.qc-card-title}

Find the reports folder and check the summary report to see which outputs are ready to review.
:::

::: {.qc-nav-card}
[4.3 Rate the reports](qc/reports.qmd){.qc-card-title}

Open `reports/index.html`, choose **Explore reports**, and rate the available images. Use the examples for each report type as a reference.
:::

::: {.qc-nav-card}
[4.4 Export ratings and rerun if needed](qc/rerun.qmd){.qc-card-title}

If you rerun a subject, review the new images first. Export your final ratings from the report menu.
:::

:::

## Examples by report type {#qc-categories}

[Browse the example galleries](qc/reports.qmd#examples-by-report-type) for the report you are rating.
